itemUsage.en: Defender Operator Mechanic has been integrated into your command structure effective immediately.
itemUsage.zh: 重装干员机械师，即日起纳入你的指挥序列。

itemDesc.en: In truth, however, you have long since been written into his chain of command. After all, countless devices you have used were created by him—and remain under his control.
itemDesc.zh: 但其实，你早就已经被列入了他的指挥序列。毕竟，你用过的许许多多设备，都由他创造，也由他掌控。

description.en: Attack Interval <@ba.vdown>increases</>; attacks become a <@ba.vup>5-hit</> area attack, each dealing Physical damage equal to <@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale:0%}</> ATK\n<@ba.rem>Loaded with {attack@trigger_time} ammo; skill ends when all ammo is spent (can be manually deactivated at any time)</>

description.en: ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>; self and Structural Principle immediately gain a <$ba.barrier>Barrier</> equal to <@ba.vup>{hp_ratio:0%}</> of Max HP. When the <$ba.barrier>Barrier</> is destroyed, deals Arts damage equal to <@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</> ATK and inflicts <$ba.tremble>Frighten</> for <@ba.vup>{not_combat}</> seconds to nearby enemies, and consumes 1 ammo to gain the <$ba.barrier>Barrier</> again\n<@ba.rem>Loaded with {trigger_time} ammo; skill ends when all ammo is spent (can be manually deactivated at any time)</>
description.zh: 攻击力<@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>，自身和结构性原理立刻获得最大生命<@ba.vup>{hp_ratio:0%}</>的<$ba.barrier>屏障</>，<$ba.barrier>屏障</>被摧毁时对周围敌人造成攻击力<@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</>的法术伤害和<@ba.vup>{not_combat}</>秒的<$ba.tremble>战栗</>，并消耗1发弹药再次获得<$ba.barrier>屏障</>\n<@ba.rem>攻击装有{trigger_time}发弹药，打完后结束（可随时停止技能）</>

description.en: ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>, Attack Interval <@ba.vdown>greatly increases</>; attacks become cross-shaped area attacks dealing Arts damage equal to <@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale:0%}</> ATK to all enemies, and can attack targets Blocked by Structural Principle\nStructural Principle Charges forward, dealing Physical damage equal to <@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</> of Mechanist's ATK to all enemies in range and stopping upon colliding with an enemy or elevated tile, inflicting a decaying 50% <$ba.weaken>Enfeeble</> effect on surrounding enemies
description.zh: 攻击力<@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>，攻击间隔<@ba.vdown>大幅增大</>，攻击变为对十字范围内所有敌人造成攻击力<@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale:0%}</>的法术伤害，可攻击结构性原理阻挡的目标\n结构性原理向前方冲锋，碰到敌人或高台时对范围内所有敌人造成机械师攻击力<@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</>的物理伤害并停下，周围的敌人获得逐渐衰减的50%的<$ba.weaken>虚弱</>效果

description.en:
Operator Mechanist excels at holding positions and intercepting enemies.
Per Field Operations Department resolution,
assigned as a Defender Operator in field missions, performing the duties of a Sentinel Protector.
This medal is hereby conferred
in witness thereof.
description.zh:
干员机械师擅长坚守阵地，阻击敌人
根据外勤部门决议
在外勤任务中划分为重装干员，行使哨戒铁卫职责
特别颁发此证章
以兹证明

description.en:
Elite Operator Mechanist, Special Field Operator clearance is now granted.
Designated tactical options have been configured for Integrated Strategies series missions.
This medal is hereby conferred
in witness thereof.
"Protocol established."
description.zh:
精英干员机械师，特别外勤干员权限现已开放
已为其配置集成战略系列任务定向战术选择
特别颁发此证章
以兹证明
“协议成立。”
